summary: Acquired by **PAR Technology** for $132.0M (mostly PAR stock), closed Dec 31, 2024 — see PAR (round one)
At acquisition: 30,000+ locations; 125+ brands including 40 of the top 50 North American concepts; clients Taco Bell, KFC, Pizza Hut, IHOP, Burger King
Franchisee analytics, loss prevention and ops insights — now part of PAR's back-office/data stack (with Data Central and Bridg)
Gives PAR a strong franchisee back-office foothold in Yum and RBI systems — overlapping Genius Back Office (RTI), which also serves RBI
Jason Tober — Delaget CEO at acquisition

PAR acquired Delaget effective December 31, 2024; PAR described more than 30,000 locations and launched PAR OPS combining its analytics with PAR Data Central. (Scope note: Acquisition-era site count is older than 18 months; present live sites and product migration need confirmation.)
